Dear Distribuciones Sanitarias del Norte S.A.,

We are writing to bring to your attention a discrepancy between invoice N-77002 (INV-0007) and our purchase order PO-0002.

Upon review, we have identified the following difference:

SKU MASK-IIR: The unit price on the invoice is 3.40 EUR, whereas the purchase order specified 3.00 EUR. This represents an overcharge of 0.40 EUR per unit, resulting in a total discrepancy of 20.00 EUR.

The amount in dispute is 20.00 EUR.

We kindly request that you provide either a corrected invoice reflecting the agreed-upon prices or a credit note for the amount in dispute.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards

Dear Material Clinico Levante S.L.,

We are writing to bring to your attention a discrepancy between invoice LV-0303 (INV-0008) and our purchase order PO-0003.

Upon receipt and verification of the goods, we identified the following difference:

SKU GAUZE-NS-5: Quantity discrepancy of -25.00 EUR (expected 40.0 units, received 35.0 units)

The total amount in dispute is 0.00 EUR.

We kindly request that you provide either a corrected invoice or a credit note to resolve this matter.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this issue.

Best regards

Dear Suministros Medicos Iberia S.L.,

We are writing to bring to your attention a discrepancy between invoice F-2026-1004 (INV-0009) and purchase order PO-0004.

Our records indicate the following difference:

- ALC70-500: 10.00 EUR (5 units at 2.00 EUR per unit - this line item was not included in the purchase order)

The total amount in dispute is 10.00 EUR.

We kindly request that you provide either a corrected invoice or a credit note to resolve this matter.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this issue.

Best regards

Dear Distribuciones Sanitarias del Norte S.A.,

We are writing to bring to your attention discrepancies between invoice N-77005 (INV-0010) and our purchase order PO-0005.

The following differences have been identified:

- SAL-250: 60.00 units invoiced at 1.80 EUR per unit, totaling 108.00 EUR (this line was not in the purchase order)
- SAL-500: 60.00 units were ordered at 1.80 EUR per unit, totaling 108.00 EUR (this line is missing from the invoice)

The total amount in dispute is 108.00 EUR.

We kindly request that you provide either a corrected invoice or a credit note to resolve these discrepancies.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards
